description: This file is a header file (.h) defining interface functions and macros related to WPA supplicant configuration file handling for a networking project. It includes function declarations for creating and updating configuration files, as well as a macro defining a directory path.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_create
methods.description: Creates a WPA supplicant configuration file for a given endpoint and filename.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_createExt
methods.description: Creates or extends the WPA supplicant configuration file for a given endpoint.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_globalConfigUpdate
methods.description: Updates a global configuration key-value pair in the specified configuration path.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_networkConfigUpdate
methods.description: Updates a network-specific configuration key-value pair in the specified configuration path.
